description: Help educators create evidence-based, grade-appropriate feedback that shows learners where they are relative to the learning goal and gives them a clear next move.

defaultPrompt: Help me generate meaningful feedback for learning.
interface.longDescription: Create concise, evidence-based feedback aligned to a Learning Target, task, and learner work. Distinguish feedback from praise, evaluation, and generic advice; prioritize task, process, and self-regulation feedback; and produce grade-appropriate language learners can understand and use to improve.
